name: deletion_policy
desc: What happens on the device when objects managed by the resource are removed. `delete` deletes the object on destroy, including any configuration not managed by Terraform, and deletes single child objects once none of their attributes are configured anymore, unless the device holds other entries below them. `reset` deletes the objects created by the resource on destroy, resets the managed attribut…

name: device
desc: A device name from the provider configuration.

name: svi_interfaces
desc: List of SVI interfaces. - Map key: `interface_id` - Must match first field in the output of `show intf brief`. Example: `vlan100`.

name: svi_interfaces[*].admin_state
desc: Administrative state. - Choices: `down`, `up`

name: svi_interfaces[*].autostate
desc: Autostate Enabled?

name: svi_interfaces[*].bandwidth
desc: Specifies the administrative port bandwidth. - Range: `1`-`400000000`

name: svi_interfaces[*].carrier_delay
desc: The hold period for which carrier transition, such as L2 interfacing going down, is ignored. - Range: `0`-`60000`

name: svi_interfaces[*].delay
desc: Specifies the administrative port delay. - Range: `1`-`16777215`

name: svi_interfaces[*].description
desc: Tunnel Description.

name: svi_interfaces[*].evpn_multihoming_core_tracking
desc: Enabled/Disabled state of Core Tracking. - Choices: `disabled`, `enabled` - Minimum NX-OS version: `10.6(1)`

name: svi_interfaces[*].inband_management
desc: An in-band management interface configuration.

name: svi_interfaces[*].load_interval_counter_1
desc: Load-averaging Interval 1. - Range: `60`-`600`

name: svi_interfaces[*].load_interval_counter_2
desc: Load-averaging Interval 2. - Range: `60`-`600`

name: svi_interfaces[*].load_interval_counter_3
desc: Load-averaging Interval 3. - Range: `60`-`600`

name: svi_interfaces[*].mac_address
desc: The MAC address.

name: svi_interfaces[*].medium
desc: Indicates the administrative port medium type. - Choices: `bcast`, `p2p`

name: svi_interfaces[*].mtu
desc: The administrative MTU port on the aggregated interface. - Range: `64`-`9216`

name: svi_interfaces[*].mtu_inherit
desc: A property for specifying if the MTU is inherited from global policy.

name: svi_interfaces[*].multisite_interface_tracking
desc: Configure EVPN multisite tracking for DCI/Fabric interface. - Choices: `unknown`, `dci`, `fabric`

name: svi_interfaces[*].snmp_trap_link_status
desc: SNMP Trap Link Status Enabled?

name: svi_interfaces[*].vlan_id
desc: The VLAN ID associated with the SVI. - Range: `0`-`4095`

name: svi_interfaces[*].vrf_dn
desc: DN of VRF. For example: `sys/inst-VRF1`.
